info.title: Runnelix development API
info.description: Local development API. Literal loopback Host required; browser Origin must equal configured RUNNELIX_BROWSER_ORIGIN. Workspace paths scope data but are not user authentication. The runs POST route remains admission-only; execute POST runs the pinned graph. Requests <=256 KiB; run inputs and node payloads <=8 KiB. Lists have a stable ID cursor and 50-row pages. Credentials are write-only and encrypted; metadata includes destination and grants are explicit. Optional oidc mode verifies identity tokens and enforces issuer/subject workspace memberships on every workspace route. Roles and explicit publish, execute, and dataRead grants govern access. See docs/implementation/phase-5-memberships.md. Development mode remains loopback-only. Configured local browser login uses authorization code with S256 PKCE and an HttpOnly opaque session cookie. Cookie-authenticated writes require the exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token. See docs/implementation/phase-5-sessions.md.

get.description: Requires configured public OIDC client. Creates a ten-minute single-use challenge and HttpOnly login cookie, then redirects to the fixed provider using S256 PKCE and nonce. No return URL parameter is accepted.

Validates cookie-bound state, consumes challenge once, exchanges code with PKCE, verifies ID token and nonce, rotates the opaque session, and redirects to configured origin /. Failure redirects to /?login=failed without provider details.
Returns mode and sign-in availability without authentication; a valid session adds principal, expiry, and CSRF token. Missing/expired cookies are cleared and reported as unauthenticated. No-store.

browserSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly cookie for HTTP loopback. HTTPS loopback uses __Host-runnelix_session with Secure. Browser login must be configured; workspace membership is still required.
